name: Sticky note
oneLiner: a real square sticky note (scanned paper tinted sticky yellow or the brand colour, its bottom edge curled off the wall) slaps on with a strip of masking tape and a marker note writes itself on, boiling on twos
say: when the speaker gives a rule, a reminder or a takeaway ('write this down', 'my one rule is'): the note slaps on as they start the line and the words write on as they say them
